title: Don't Open the Door
hook: I got trapped in a Pulsebox game. Something outside knows my friend's voice

messages.text: Jay clicked play on One More Night... and woke up in a forest. The sun was going down. Fast.
messages.label: ONE MORE NIGHT · NIGHT 1

messages.text: Okay. Okay okay okay. There's a cabin. Run. Just run!
He boarded every window. He started the generator. Then... the whole forest went silent.
milo i'm IN one more night. it's getting dark
watchers freeze in your flashlight. and jay... whatever happens, DON'T open the door
Between the trees, tall pale things stood perfectly still. Every time his flashlight moved... they got closer.
messages.label: 11:58 PM

messages.text: Don't move the light... don't move the light...
Then... three knocks on the cabin door.
messages.label: 1:13 AM

messages.text: Jay? Jay, it's me, Milo! Open the door, it's freezing out here!
jay I'M HOME IN BED. that is *NOT* me
The knocking stopped. Then the boards on the window started coming off. One... by one.
Milo! What do I do?! WHAT DO I DO?!
THE RADIO. 107. call for rescue
Jay spun the dial to one-oh-seven. Static... and then a voice.
This is Rescue One. We see your cabin. Hold on, we're coming in.
Rotor blades. A searchlight. The sun came up... and Jay woke up at his desk.
messages.label: 6:02 AM

messages.text: Then someone knocked on his bedroom door.
Jay? It's me. Let me in.
yo you up? i just woke up lol
One More Night and eight more horror games, free on Pulsebox. box.pulseform.org. It's a computer game site, so play it on a computer. And if something knocks... don't answer it.
